name: Willow Farms
description: A working berry farm in Red Level, AL, Willow Farms grows Blueberries, Pears, Figs, and Honey. The farm is busiest in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
